headline: Malaysia GDP expands 5.5% in third quarter on household demand and tech boom
summary: Malaysia's economy expanded 5.5% year-on-year in the third quarter, beating forecasts due to resilient household spending and strong technology exports supported by global artificial intelligence demand.
why: Malaysia is a key hub in the global semiconductor assembly, testing, and packaging supply chain, making its GDP sensitive to tech cycles.
